Definition at scan time: Number of audited baskets whose validity intervals include the scan.
Number of distinct token books needed by those active baskets; shared legs are counted once.
Previously observed active tokens divided by all active tokens; always one among eligible scans.
Active tokens with nonempty two-sided, non-crossed books divided by all active tokens.
Mean best ask minus best bid across clean active member books; missing if none are clean.
Largest best-ask-minus-best-bid difference across clean active members.
Sum of displayed ask quantities at all recorded levels across distinct active tokens.
Largest elapsed source-time age among the latest observed active member snapshots.
Maximum guaranteed payoff minus depth-integrated ask cost across supported basket quantities; negative values are retained.
Active baskets with a finite, size- and tick-compatible quoted margin divided by all active baskets.
Active baskets whose best quoted margin exceeds zero divided by all active baskets; missing margins do not count as positive.
